title: Schroeter (inter-hostel sports)
summary: The year-long inter-hostel sports championship: events, scoring, Gymkhana Day.

posts.md:
**Schroeter** is IIT Madras' annual **Inter-Hostel Sports Championship**, where all hostels compete across a wide range of sports to earn points throughout the academic year. The hostel with the highest overall points is crowned the **Schroeter Champion** and takes home the prestigious **Schroeter Cup**.

The championship promotes:
- Sportsmanship
- Healthy competition
- Physical fitness
- Hostel spirit and unity

Separate championships are conducted for **Men** and **Women**.

## Women's Schroeter Events

Women's Schroeter includes:

- Athletics
- Badminton
- Basketball
- Chess
- Swimming
- Table Tennis
- Tennis
- Volleyball

## Men's Schroeter Events

Men compete in all the events above, along with:

- Cricket
- Football
- Hockey
- Squash
- Water Polo
- Weightlifting

## How is the Winner Decided?

- Every inter-hostel competition awards points based on performance.
- The hostel with the **highest total points** at the end of the academic year wins the **Schroeter Trophy**.
- Separate trophies are awarded for **Men's** and **Women's** championships.
- In case of a tie, the hostel with the **most gold (first-place) finishes in team events** is declared the winner.

## Awards

### Team Events
- Gold – Winners
- Silver – Runners-up
- Bronze – Second Runners-up
- Merit Certificates – Up to 4th Place

### Individual Events
(Athletics, Swimming, Weightlifting, etc.)

- Medals – Top 3
- Merit Certificates – Up to 4th Place

## Gymkhana Day

The academic year's sporting season concludes with **Gymkhana Day**, where:

- Schroeter Trophies are presented.
- Medals and certificates are awarded.
- Champion hostels celebrate their victories.

## Why Schroeter is Special

For many students, Schroeter is one of the most memorable experiences at IIT Madras.

Weeks of practice, representing your hostel, competing alongside friends, and hearing your hostel cheer from the sidelines creates an unmatched atmosphere. Winning for your hostel is more than just earning points—it's about pride, teamwork, and unforgettable memories.

Whether you're a beginner or an experienced athlete, Schroeter is the perfect opportunity to:
- Represent your hostel
- Make new friends
- Stay active
- Compete across multiple sports
- Experience one of IITM's biggest annual traditions

> **Every point counts. Every match matters. Play for your hostel and be part of the Schroeter legacy! **
